results.answer: Days to pay by payer class.
results.final_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,payer_class, min(submission_date) sd FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2,3), r AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,payment_date FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount>0) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims, round(median(payment_date-sd),1) AS median_days, round(quantile_cont(payment_date-sd,0.9),1) AS p90_days FROM p JOIN r USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Top 5 CO denial CARCs on denied current adjudications: 18 (4), then 11, 16, 22, 96 (2 each).
results.final_sql: SELECT carc_code, count(DISTINCT claim_key||'|'||payer_key) AS denied_claims FROM sem.adjustments a WHERE is_current_adjudication AND group_code='CO' AND is_denial_carc AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=a.claim_key AND r.payer_key=a.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

results.answer: First-pass resolution by payer class.
results.final_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT payer_class, claim_key, payer_key, count(*) n, bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) ok FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS pairs_remitted, sum((n=1 AND ok)::int) AS first_pass_resolved, round(100.0*sum((n=1 AND ok)::int)/count(*),2) AS rate_pct FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Multi-trace claim+payer pairs by payer class.
results.final_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT payer_class, claim_key, payer_key, count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) nt, bool_or(is_reversal) rv, bool_or(is_current_adjudication) cur, sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pairs, sum(rv::int) AS with_reversal, sum((NOT cur)::int) AS no_current, round(coalesce(sum(paid),0),2) AS current_paid FROM x WHERE nt>=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Top-5 referring provider concentration per service month.
results.final_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, referring_npi, service_date_from FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission), m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month',service_date_from) mo, referring_npi, count(*) n FROM l WHERE service_date_from>=DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mo ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi) rk FROM m) SELECT strftime(mo,'%Y-%m') AS month, sum(n) AS total_claims, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5) AS top5_claims, round(100.0*sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk<=5)/sum(n),1) AS top5_share_pct FROM r GROUP BY mo ORDER BY mo

results.answer: Only 3 CPTs reach 20 adjudications: 36415 3.85%, 80053 0%, 85025 0%.
results.final_sql: WITH ca AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication), cp AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key,procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines) SELECT procedure_code, count(*) AS adjudications, sum(is_denied::int) AS denied, round(100.0*sum(is_denied::int)/count(*),2) AS denial_rate_pct FROM ca JOIN cp USING(claim_key,payer_key) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20 ORDER BY denial_rate_pct DESC, procedure_code

results.answer: Primary denial rate by line-count bucket.
results.final_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key,payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'), r AS (SELECT r.claim_key, r.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN p USING(claim_key,payer_key) WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) SELECT CASE WHEN line_count>=3 THEN '3+' ELSE line_count::varchar END AS bucket, count(*) AS claims, sum(is_denied::int) AS denied, round(100.0*sum(is_denied::int)/count(*),2) AS denial_rate_pct, coalesce(sum(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied),0) AS denied_billed FROM r JOIN l USING(claim_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Each FB carry-forward with its offsetting later FB (null if not yet offset).
results.final_sql: WITH cf AS (SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount amt FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code='FB' AND provider_adjustment_amount<0), off AS (SELECT cf.reference_id, cf.payment_date, min(o.payment_date) od FROM cf JOIN sem.provider_adjustments o ON o.plb_reason_code='FB' AND o.payer_key=cf.payer_key AND o.reference_id=cf.reference_id AND o.provider_adjustment_amount=-cf.amt AND o.payment_date>cf.payment_date GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT cf.reference_id, cf.payment_date AS carried_forward_date, round(-cf.amt,2) AS amount_carried, off.od AS offset_date, datediff('day', cf.payment_date, off.od) AS days_between FROM cf LEFT JOIN off USING(reference_id, payment_date) ORDER BY cf.payment_date, cf.reference_id

results.answer: July vs August paid mix by payer class. No August 2026 payments exist in the data, so August shares and changes are null. Assumption: current adjudications by payment month.
results.final_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT payer_class, payment_month m, sum(paid_amount) p FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01') GROUP BY 1,2), s AS (SELECT payer_class, m, p/sum(p) OVER (PARTITION BY m) sh FROM c), cls AS (SELECT DISTINCT payer_class FROM c) SELECT cls.payer_class, round(100*j.sh,1) AS july_share_pct, round(100*a.sh,1) AS aug_share_pct, round(100*(a.sh-j.sh),1) AS change_pp FROM cls LEFT JOIN s j ON j.payer_class=cls.payer_class AND j.m=DATE '2026-07-01' LEFT JOIN s a ON a.payer_class=cls.payer_class AND a.m=DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY 1

results.answer: 10 corrected replacements to primary; their originals predate the data so cycle-time averages are null; 1 paid after replacement, $34.64.
results.final_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) od FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND frequency_code='1' GROUP BY 1,2), rp AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' AND frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), b AS (SELECT * FROM rp LEFT JOIN o USING(claim_key,payer_key)), ca AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,payment_date,paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication) SELECT count(*) AS corrected_claims, round(avg(rd-od),2) AS avg_days_to_replacement, count(ca.payment_date) FILTER (WHERE ca.payment_date>=rd) AS paid_after_replacement, round(avg(ca.payment_date-od) FILTER (WHERE ca.payment_date>=rd),2) AS avg_days_orig_to_pay, coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE ca.payment_date>=rd),0) AS total_paid FROM b LEFT JOIN ca USING(claim_key,payer_key)

results.answer: No frequency-8 void submissions exist in sem.claims for this data window, so all counts are 0.
results.final_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) vd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='8' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT v.claim_key, bool_or(r.paid_amount>0 AND r.payment_date<v.vd) paid_before, bool_or(r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date>=v.vd) rev, sum(r.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_current_adjudication) cur FROM v LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=v.claim_key AND r.payer_key=v.payer_key GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS voided_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_before) AS paid_before_void, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rev) AS reversed_after_void, round(coalesce(sum(cur),0),2) AS current_paid FROM r

results.final_sql: WITH rp AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,payer_class,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2,3), f AS (SELECT rp.payer_class, rp.claim_key, min(r.payment_date)-rp.rd d FROM rp JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=rp.claim_key AND r.payer_key=rp.payer_key AND r.payment_date>=rp.rd GROUP BY 1,2,rp.rd) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS corrected_claims, round(avg(d),1) AS avg_days, min(d) AS min_days, max(d) AS max_days FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: July primary cohort remit-within-14-days share by payer class.
results.final_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,payer_class,min(submission_date) sd FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING min(submission_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'), f AS (SELECT c.*, (SELECT min(payment_date) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=c.claim_key AND r.payer_key=c.payer_key) fp FROM c) SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS cohort_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fp-sd<=14) AS remitted_within_14d, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fp-sd<=14)/count(*),1) AS pct FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: One corrected claim had a prior recorded denial; no remit since the correction.
results.final_sql: WITH rp AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) rd FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code='7' GROUP BY 1,2), d AS (SELECT DISTINCT rp.claim_key, rp.payer_key, rp.rd FROM rp JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=rp.claim_key AND r.payer_key=rp.payer_key AND r.claim_status_code='4' AND r.payment_date<rp.rd), o AS (SELECT d.claim_key, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=d.claim_key AND r.payer_key=d.payer_key AND r.payment_date>=d.rd) THEN 'no remit since correction' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=d.claim_key AND r.payer_key=d.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND NOT r.is_denied) THEN 'overturned' ELSE 'denied again' END outcome, (SELECT sum(paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=d.claim_key AND r.payer_key=d.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication) paid FROM d) SELECT outcome, count(*) AS claims, round(coalesce(sum(paid),0),2) AS current_paid FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.answer: Overturned denials: superseded non-reversal denied event, current not denied.
results.final_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key, bool_or(adjudication_state='superseded' AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied) ed, bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) cnd, sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT count(*) AS overturned, coalesce(sum(paid),0) AS total_current_paid FROM x WHERE ed AND cnd

results.answer: Open primary AR aging as of 2026-08-14.
results.final_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT claim_key, frequency_code, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission), p AS (SELECT claim_key,payer_key,min(submission_date) sd FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P' GROUP BY 1,2), o AS (SELECT p.claim_key, DATE '2026-08-14'-p.sd age, l.charge_amount FROM p JOIN l USING(claim_key) WHERE l.frequency_code<>'8' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=p.claim_key AND r.payer_key=p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)) SELECT CASE WHEN age<=14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age<=29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END AS bucket, count(*) AS claims, sum(charge_amount) AS billed FROM o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(age)

results.answer: Claims first submitted in July 2026 with no 835 at all.
results.final_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) d FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) AS never_remitted FROM f WHERE d >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND d < DATE '2026-08-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key=f.claim_key)

results.answer: Underpaid lines vs payer typical allowed (mode, ties high) per payer.
results.final_sql: WITH l AS (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount a FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied AND units_paid=1 AND line_allowed_amount>0), t AS (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, a typ FROM (SELECT payer_name, procedure_code, a, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_name, procedure_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC, a DESC) rk FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3) WHERE rk=1), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT payer_name FROM l) SELECT p.payer_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.a<t.typ) AS underpaid_lines, round(coalesce(sum(t.typ-l.a) FILTER (WHERE l.a<t.typ),0),2) AS shortfall FROM p LEFT JOIN l USING(payer_name) LEFT JOIN t USING(payer_name, procedure_code) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shortfall DESC, 1

results.answer: Monthly denial rate by payer class; only July 2026 present so change is null.
